name: copilot-buddy
description: Bring the models in your signed-in WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI desktop app into VS Code Copilot Chat. Zero configuration: reuses the desktop app login and credits.

workbuddy.authFile.markdownDescription: Explicit path to the domestic WorkBuddy desktop app's auth file (`workbuddy-desktop.info`). Leave empty to auto-discover. Overrides the `WORKBUDDY_AUTH_FILE` environment variable.

workbuddy.aiAuthFile.markdownDescription: Explicit path to the WorkBuddy AI (international) desktop app's auth file (`workbuddy-desktop-ai.info`). Leave empty to auto-discover. Overrides the `WORKBUDDY_AI_AUTH_FILE` environment variable.

workbuddy.electronBinary.markdownDescription: Explicit path to the domestic WorkBuddy desktop app's executable, used to decrypt WorkBuddy 5.6+ credentials at rest. Leave empty to auto-discover. Overrides the `WORKBUDDY_ELECTRON_BIN` environment variable.

workbuddy.aiElectronBinary.markdownDescription: Explicit path to the WorkBuddy AI (international) desktop app's executable, used to decrypt WorkBuddy 5.6+ credentials at rest. Leave empty to auto-discover. Overrides the `WORKBUDDY_AI_ELECTRON_BIN` environment variable.
